# Abasiofon Sendan — Backend Engineer

Backend engineer based in Nigeria. Builds APIs, webhook delivery systems, and data pipelines. 5+ years shipping backend systems.

## Stack

Python, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Supabase, Go, Redis, Docker

## What I Do

- Design and build REST APIs
- Webhook delivery infrastructure (Go)
- Rate limiting, background jobs, event-driven systems
- Database design and query optimization

## Experience

**Backend Engineer — Kauchy (2026–present)**
Backend for a social commerce platform for student vendors, built with Django and Django REST Framework. Made escrow crediting idempotent and transaction-safe so duplicate or delayed Paystack webhooks never double-credited vendors. Prevented overselling and price-tampering on direct checkouts by freezing order state across the external payment redirect, and eliminated race conditions in multi-vendor checkout with an atomic order pipeline. Real-time chat and notifications ran on Django Channels and Redis.

**Backend Developer (Contract) — Agrovest (2024–2025)**
Django backend for an agriculture investment platform. Built the Python/Django REST API as modular, decoupled components that stayed easy to extend as the platform grew. Optimized transaction processing for a 20% speed improvement and sped up retrieval of investment-cycle and returns data by tuning the underlying NoSQL databases. Cut manual admin work 70% by digitizing investor and farm data.
